Had an amazing time at Maxus Cinema, Bhayandar! 🎬🍿

The movie experience was fantastic with comfortable seating, great sound quality, and a lively atmosphere. What made the visit even more memorable were the fun moments spent with family and friends, enjoying every scene and sharing lots of laughs together.

featured_reviews.name: Dreams unlimited By Divya joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently watched a movie at Maxus Cinema Bhayandar and had a really enjoyable experience 🎬✨ The theatre ambience is lively, fully air-conditioned and perfect for a fun movie outing with family or friends. Seats were comfortable, sound quality was powerful and the screen experience felt quite immersive 😍
Loved that they have multiple screen options like Atmos, Gold Class, Director Lounge and recliner seating which makes the experience even better. The food counters and overall mall vibe add to the fun too 😋 Parking and ticket booking facilities are convenient as well.
Movie shows usually start from morning and continue till late night depending on releases and weekends. Located inside Maxus Mall near Bhayandar West flyover, it’s one of the most popular cinemas in the Mira Bhayandar area for affordable yet enjoyable movie experiences ❤️ Definitely a great place for weekend entertainment!

featured_reviews.name: Zoya Khatoon
featured_reviews.review_text:
While the overall setup and facilities were good, the experience was disappointing due to the atmosphere inside the theatre. The crowd was excessively loud throughout the movie, with constant talking and disturbances that made it difficult to stay immersed in the film. For the amount spent on tickets, I expected a much more enjoyable and comfortable viewing experience.

It would really help if stricter monitoring is enforced during screenings—perhaps with staff conducting periodic checks or clear announcements requesting audiences to maintain silence. Better crowd management and ensuring basic theatre etiquette would go a long way in improving the experience for everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Akash Mhapankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently went for an evening show of De De Pyaar De 2, and it turned out to be a great choice. The movie was full of comedy, light moments, and entertainment — we enjoyed every bit of it.

After the movie, we headed to the food court to grab something to eat. We tried their pizza and red sauce pasta, both of which were tasty and satisfying. For drinks, we had orange juice and strawberry bubbles — refreshing and perfect after a long movie.

Overall, it was a fun and enjoyable outing with good entertainment and good food. Would definitely recommend both the movie and the food court experience!

featured_reviews.name: Sumit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Maxus Cinema Screen No. 6 (Gold Class), and honestly the experience was extremely disappointing.
Almost every seat was torn and badly maintained, the side trays were broken, and the overall hygiene inside the hall was very poor. For a “Gold Class” screen, this level of maintenance is unacceptable.
The worst part was the red illuminated staircase lights — they were so bright that their reflection was directly visible on the screen throughout the movie, completely ruining the cinematic experience. Instead of enjoying the film, the constant reflection became distracting and irritating.
I am sharing photos as well so the management can clearly understand the condition and hopefully take immediate action to improve the maintenance and viewing experience.

featured_reviews.name: Dreams unlimited By Divya joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Maxus Mall and had a really good experience 😊 One of the most popular malls in the Mira Bhayandar area for shopping, movies, food and family outings ❤️ The mall has a nice mix of branded stores, food outlets, gaming zone and a multiplex, so there’s something for everyone.
The ambience is lively, spacious and family friendly. Especially loved the cinema experience — comfortable seating, good sound quality and multiple movie options available 😍 Food court also has many tasty options for quick bites and casual meals.
Mall is generally open from around 11 AM to 10 PM and the location is very convenient near Bhayandar West flyover. Parking facility is available too. Perfect place to chill with friends, enjoy movies, shopping and spend quality family time ✨ Definitely a go-to hangout spot nearby!

featured_reviews.name: Rajiv Bhor
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Hotel is located on Temba Road in Bhayandar West, Thane District, Maharashtra. It offers a range of accommodations, including rooms and suites, and features amenities such as banquet halls, free Wi-Fi, and on-site parking.

Pros:

Convenient Location: The hotel is situated near popular attractions like Maxus Mall (approximately 0.08 km away) and Mandali Talav (about 0.5 km away), making it suitable for guests interested in shopping and sightseeing.

Amenities: Guests have access to facilities such as a lounge, vending machines, and dry cleaning services.

Cons:

Lack of Guest Reviews: There is a noticeable absence of detailed guest reviews and ratings on major travel platforms, making it challenging to assess the quality of service and overall guest satisfaction.

Strict Policies: The hotel enforces policies such as not allowing unmarried couples and guests below 18 years of age. Additionally, smoking within the premises is prohibited.

Given the limited availability of guest feedback, potential visitors might consider reaching out directly to the hotel for more detailed information or exploring other accommodations in the area with more comprehensive reviews.

It’s the perfect spot for families looking to balance a bit of retail therapy with outdoor fun for the little ones!

featured_reviews.name: CS Rahul Taori
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited MovieMax Mira Road, and overall it was a good experience, especially considering its proximity to my residence.
The biggest advantage of this theatre is its location and convenience — very easy to access if you stay nearby, making it a go-to option for quick movie plans without much travel hassle.
Talking about the theatre itself, the seating, screen quality, and sound system are quite decent. It may not be ultra-premium, but it delivers a comfortable and enjoyable movie experience.
One major downside, however, is the food and beverages. The pricing is quite high compared to the quality and quantity offered. Honestly, it doesn’t feel worth the money, and this is something they really need to improve.
On the positive side, ticket prices are affordable, which balances out the experience to some extent and makes it a budget-friendly entertainment option.
Final Verdict:
A convenient and reliable theatre for regular movie outings, but avoid spending much on food inside.
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5)

featured_reviews.name: Rouque Nation
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Cinema in Virar

Absolutely terrible experience at Rockstar Cinema, Virar.

Right from the entrance, there was no proper security. Instead of trained staff, a little girl was casually asking for tickets, which felt completely unprofessional and unsafe.

As soon as we entered the cinema hall area, there was a horrible stench—like a rotten rat had died somewhere. When we informed the staff, instead of fixing the issue, they just sprayed some air freshener, which made it even worse.

I had booked an M Gold ticket, but the seat was broken. I had to adjust uncomfortably throughout the movie because no staff member was willing to help or even bother.

During the National Anthem, there was no sound at all. People just stood up and sat down in silence, completely ruining the experience and showing zero respect for the moment.

The food counter was equally disappointing—nothing was available. No samosa, no water, no cold drinks, no popcorn. The only thing they had was stale nachos with oily mayonnaise, which looked completely inedible.

Overall, a very disappointing and frustrating experience. Poor management, lack of basic facilities, and no concern for customers. Definitely not visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: Prem Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This movie theatre is located very close to the area, making it a highly convenient option for regular visits. One of the best things about this place is that it feels quite pocket-friendly, especially when compared to some of the bigger multiplex chains. However, it’s always a good idea to compare the pricing and features with PVR before making a final decision, particularly if looking for a more premium movie experience.

The seating arrangement here is surprisingly good for the price point. The regular seats offer decent comfort and support throughout the movie. That said, the sofa seats are not really worth the extra money – they don't add significant value in terms of comfort or luxury, so it's better to stick with the standard seating options.

The staff at this theatre are well-behaved and helpful. Their treatment of visitors is polite and respectful. One standout feature is their on-seat food service, which is quick and makes the experience more enjoyable.

The theatre is located in Nalasopara, making it a great choice for locals. Both the screen quality and sound system exceed expectations for this price range. For a budget-friendly yet satisfying cinematic experience, this theatre is definitely worth considering.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Maxus Cinemas on Gorai Road, Borivali West recently. Overall, the experience was decent, but there are a few areas that need improvement.

The biggest disappointment was that the movie started almost 30 minutes late, which was quite frustrating and affected the overall experience. The management should ensure better punctuality and timely show schedules.

The theatre is clean and the seating is comfortable. Food quality was surprisingly good, with decent options available and fresh snacks. However, the sound quality was slightly below expectations. The audio lacked depth and could definitely be improved for a better cinematic experience.

Despite these issues, the ambience is pleasant and it's still a good option for a casual movie outing with friends and family. Hoping they improve the sound system and maintain better show timings in the future.

⭐⭐⭐☆☆ (3/5)

featured_reviews.name: Dj Anu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, really disappointed with my experience at Maxsus Cinema. The picture quality was extremely poor — the screen looked blurry, as if the sharpness wasn’t even set properly. For a premium theatre, this is just unacceptable.

On top of that, the audio was even worse. The speakers were crackling throughout, completely ruining the movie experience. Instead of immersive sound, it felt like sitting next to a broken speaker system.

Even the food was a letdown. The ₹100 sandwich was pathetic — dry, swaggy, and didn’t even have proper butter applied. Completely not worth the price.

Overall, not worth the money at all. Definitely expected much better from a brand like this.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Audio and visual quality are impressive, with clear sound and sharp screen projection that enhance the cinematic experience. Cleanliness is well taken care of across the premises, including the seating areas and washrooms, which adds to the comfort.

Staff are courteous and helpful, and the entry and exit process is smooth without unnecessary delays. The food counter offers decent options, and service is efficient even during peak hours.

Overall, Maxus Theatre stands out as a reliable and comfortable theatre in Borivali, ideal for family outings as well as casual movie plans. Definitely a good choice for a hassle-free movie experience.

featured_reviews.name: Girish Omre
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Cinemas in Kandivali East is a great place to watch movies with family and friends. The theatre is spacious, comfortable, and well maintained. The sound quality and screen experience are very good, making the movie experience enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: 65_CO_B_Alok Panda
featured_reviews.review_text: The experience of movie was truly amusing and phenomenal The theatre provides an excellent movie-watching experience with comfortable seating and a well-maintained environment. The sound quality is crystal clear, and the screen is large and bright, making every scene enjoyable and immersive. The theatre is very clean, including the seating area, washrooms, and waiting lounge, which shows that the management takes good care of hygiene. The staff members are polite and helpful, ensuring that customers have a smooth experience from ticket booking to the end of the show. The air conditioning is perfect, making the atmosphere pleasant even during long movies. The snack counter offers a good variety of food and beverages, and the service is quick. Overall, the theatre is a great place to relax and enjoy movies with friends and family. I highly recommend this theatre for its comfort, cleanliness, and excellent audio-visual qualit

featured_reviews.name: Pankaj Powermax
featured_reviews.review_text:
INOX at Thakur Mall in Dahisar is a popular entertainment hub for residents in the Dahisar and Mira Road areas. Located on the 3rd floor of the mall, it is known for being a well-maintained multiplex that offers a premium cinematic experience at relatively competitive prices compared to other major malls in Mumbai.
Screens: The multiplex typically operates 4 screens, featuring both 2D and 3D projection technology.
​Seating: Options range from standard comfortable seating to luxury recliners (Gold Class) for a more relaxed experience.
​Audio/Visual: Equipped with high-quality sound systems, including Dolby Atmos in select halls, and large screens with high-definition picture quality.
​Accessibility: The cinema is equipped with wheelchair facilities and elevator access.
Refreshments: There is a dedicated F&B counter inside INOX serving classic movie snacks like popcorn, nachos, and sandwiches.
​Food Court: Thakur Mall itself has a multi-cuisine food court on the lower floors, offering a wider variety of dining options after the movie.
​Gaming Zone: There is a gaming area located within the mall, making it a good spot for families and children.
If you're visiting on a weekend, it's advisable to book tickets in advance via apps like BookMyShow, as it is a major landmark and can get quite crowded for blockbuster releases.
Safety system is very nice handle nicely .

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: INOX Thakur Mall - Mira Road really impressed me! 🤩 The atmosphere was absolutely fantastic, and I had such a wonderful time. The staff was super friendly and made my visit extra special. 😊 I particularly loved the comfortable seating and the crystal-clear screen. 🎬 The snack bar had some delicious options too! 🍿😋 I'm definitely planning another trip soon; it's a great spot for a fun outing! 👍 it's just they don't have an Imax screen which is a must at every Inox Cinema 🎥📽️

featured_reviews.name: Keval Somaiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re someone who enjoys ads more than movies, this theatre is absolutely perfect for you.

Showtime? More like “suggested time.” I’ve been here multiple times, and without fail, every single show starts 20–30 minutes late. Honestly, you could walk in 20 minutes after the scheduled time and still comfortably sit through a full ad marathon before the movie even begins.

At this point, missing a scene here is nearly impossible—not because of great service, but because punctuality clearly isn’t part of the experience.

It’s hard to tell whether the staff is just taking it easy or the management has created some magical, impossible turnaround schedule between shows. Either way, the result is the same: frustration.

A 2-hour movie somehow turns into a 3-hour commitment. Impressive… just not in the way you’d want.

Would not recommend if you value your time.

featured_reviews.name: Hemang Tawadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Watched Dhurandar 2.0 at INOX Thakur Mall. The standard is quiet average with the ticket pricing they charge. Toilet cleanliness pretty average. The in house food is insanely high and seems just looting people e.g selling a regular coke at 350 INR and combo Regular Pop bucket + Coke @ 730 INR. Is INOX selling pop corn and coke over moon or they want to match meal price with Airports. Security Do not allow even soft drinks from outside.
Screens and Seating are good.
Surely Not coming back at INOX Thakur mall anytime for any show.

featured_reviews.name: 91 - Arsh Mansuri
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the worst theatre experiences I’ve had.

First of all, the show management was completely messed up. Instead of taking the interval at the proper time (when it was actually shown on screen), they randomly stopped the movie mid-scene after that and suddenly announced an interval 10 minutes later. It totally ruined the flow and mood of the film.

On top of that, the seats were extremely dusty and poorly maintained. Sitting there itself felt uncomfortable and unhygienic.

Overall, very disappointing experience — bad management and zero attention to cleanliness.

featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent auditorium, neat and clean wash rooms, polite staff, good ambience are definitely positive points but the one sour point is lack of comfortable seats in the lounge, seats are fewer too. Btw, our show at 4.45pm on Tuesday started at 4.55pm, ie we were allowed inside only at 4.55pm. Yet, 5 stars is appropriate because there is no 4.5 stars category. Overall, good experience!
